title: Firebreather 089/094 - Reverse Holo - Pokémon TCG: Phantasmal Flames Trainer
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Firebreather 089/094 card from the Pokémon TCG: Phantasmal Flames Trainer set is a Standard-sized collectible card made of card stock. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2025, this English-language Trainer-Supporter card features a unique Reverse Holo finish, making it an uncommon rarity within the Pokemon franchise. With its Firebreather character design, this card is a valuable addition for collectors and players alike in the world of Pokémon Trading Card Game.
